newsitem.title: USA: Dwyer Group restates financial statements.
newsitem.headline: Dwyer Group restates financial statements.

text.p: The Dwyer Group Inc said Friday that an error had been made relating to the carrying value of certain nonoperating individual franchises and regional franchises held for sale at December 31, 1995.
Accordingly, the company said it restated its consolidated financial statements for the year ended December 31, 1995.
Dwyer said it does not expect the adjustments to hurt 1997 operating results.

The company said the adjustments to these assets reduced previously reported total assets at December 31, 1995, by $571,445, reduced assets held for resale by $788,450, reduced liabilities by $58,147, reduced retained earnings by $513,298 and increased the previously reported net loss for the year ended December 31, 1995 by $513,298.
The net loss per share for the year ended Dec. 31, 1995, increased by $0.07 per share, the comany said.
Also Friday the company reported that for the year ended December 31, 1996, total revenues increased 3.2 percent to $14,093,000 from $13,652,000 for fiscal 1995.

Dwyer said it had a net loss of $441,000 or $0.06 cents per share for the year ended December 31, 1996, an increase of $588,000 as compared to the restated net loss of $1,029,000 or $0.14 cents per share, for the year ended December 31, 1995, respectively.
